relevance.excluded_scope: Supranational EU law; territorial and market-access scope under EU law, not a treaty regime. Military, defence and national-security uses are largely excluded by Article 2.
relevance.reason: The European Union's binding horizontal regulation of AI, collected separately from international treaties because it is supranational legislation. It establishes risk-based obligations for AI systems and providers of general-purpose AI models, prohibits certain practices and provides market-surveillance and enforcement machinery. It is not an international treaty and does not bind non-EU States as such.
